title: 第19章 叶家寿宴第20章 青冥大寿丹
content_zh:
回来的路上，玄阳大师依旧激动不已。
“师尊，现在已经得到了青莲地心火的具体位置，不知该如何去取呢？”
玄阳大师看得出来，苏尘志在必得，不由得发问道。
虽然他现在与天地奇火无缘，但多了解一些知识总是没坏处的，说不定哪天就用上了呢。
“想要炼化天地奇火，首先要拥有高明的控火之法，其次自身的精气神强度必须极高，才能承受！”
苏尘并没有藏着掖着。
玄阳大师没想到这么麻烦。
高明的控火之法已经极为难得，而且就算得到也不是那么容易修成的。
至于精气神强度，炼丹师的精神力普遍很高，还勉强能达到标准。
可真气强度和肉身强度方面，就差得远了。
那青莲地心火，让真武境巅峰的柳擎都差点殒命，可见其何等狂暴。
历史上那些炼化天地奇火的，哪一个不是名动一方的武者强者，或者丹道宗师。
即使如此，死亡率也是极高的。
而苏尘虽然掌握了三昧真火印，但修为太低了，想要强行炼化青莲地心火，也只会引火焚身，死翘翘。
等变强起来吗？
谁知道会不会被其他人发现，捷足先登？
“世事无绝对！
借助一些外力，炼化青莲地心火，也不是不可能。”
苏尘忽然神秘一笑，对玄阳大师道：“我需要你帮我搜罗一些东西……”
玄阳大师接过苏尘写好的清单，仔细一看，眼珠子差点没瞪掉。

“这是……三元归一丹和青冥大寿丹的炼制材料？”
三元归一丹乃是一种可以让人短时间内，精气神暴增的丹药。
而青冥大寿丹，则是能给人增加寿元的丹药。
两者虽然都只是四品丹药，但却无比珍稀，丹方和材料配比早就失传了。
玄阳大师，也只是在丹盟的文献中，看到过一些记载而已。
但看苏尘的意思，明显是拥有丹方配比的。
“凑齐材料，这两个丹方就是你的了！”
苏尘淡笑着说道。
玄阳大师一听，激动的差点蹦起来。
“多谢师尊！”
“师尊放心，那三元归一丹的材料虽然珍贵，但弟子可以命人从丹盟调过来，青冥大寿丹的材料，大罗商盟内都有，很快就能给师尊配齐！”
玄阳大师激动的说道。
“嗯，尽快就是。”
苏尘满意的点了点头。
玄阳大师的办事效率极高，回到大罗商盟内就给苏尘准备好了青冥大寿丹的材料。
苏尘看了一下，确定没有遗漏后，便带着青竹回府了。
content_en:
On the way back, Master Xuanyang was still excited.
"Master, now that we have obtained the specific location of the Qinglian Earth Core Fire, I don't know how to get it?"
Master Xuanyang could tell that Su Chen was determined to win, so he couldn't help but ask.
Although he has no chance to know the strange fire of heaven and earth now, it never hurts to know more about it. Maybe it will be useful one day.
"If you want to refine the strange fire of heaven and earth, you must first have a superb fire control method, and secondly, your own energy and spirit must be extremely strong to be able to withstand it!"
Su Chen didn't hide it.
Master Xuanyang didn't expect it to be so troublesome.
Brilliant fire control methods are extremely rare, and even if they are obtained, they are not easy to master.
As for the strength of the spirit, the alchemist's mental strength is generally very high, and can barely reach the standard.
But in terms of the strength of the true energy and the strength of the physical body, there is a huge difference.
The inner fire of Qinglian almost killed Liu Qing, who was at the peak of the True Martial Realm, which shows how violent it is.
Among those who refined the strange fires of heaven and earth in history, none of them were famous warriors or masters of alchemy.
Even so, the mortality rate is extremely high.
Although Su Chen has mastered the True Fire Seal of Samadhi, his cultivation level is too low. If he tries to forcibly refine the Qinglian Earth Core Fire, he will only be burned to death.
Wait until you become stronger?
Who knows if others will discover it and get there first?
"There are no absolutes!
It is not impossible to refine Qinglian's inner fire with the help of some external forces. "
Su Chen suddenly smiled mysteriously and said to Master Xuanyang: "I need you to help me collect some things..."
Master Xuanyang took the list written by Su Chen and looked at it carefully, his eyes almost popped out.
"This is... the refining material for Sanyuan Guiyi Pill and Qingming Longevity Pill?"
The Sanyuan Guiyi Pill is a pill that can increase a person's energy and energy in a short period of time.
Qingming Longevity Pill is a pill that can increase people's longevity.
Although both are only fourth-grade elixirs, they are extremely rare, and the elixir recipes and ingredient ratios have long been lost.
Master Xuanyang has only seen some records in the documents of the Dan Alliance.
But judging from what Su Chen meant, it was obvious that he had the right combination of elixirs.
"Gather the materials together, and these two prescriptions are yours!"
Su Chen said with a slight smile.
When Master Xuanyang heard this, he almost jumped up with excitement.
"Thank you Master!"
"Master, don't worry. Although the materials for the Three Yuan Guiyi Dan are precious, the disciple can order someone to transfer them from the Dan Alliance. The materials for the Qingming Longevity Dan are available in the Daluo Shang Alliance, and they will be ready for Master soon!"
Master Xuanyang said excitedly.
"Well, as soon as possible."
Su Chen nodded with satisfaction.
Master Xuanyang was very efficient in his work. When he returned to the Daluo Business Alliance, he prepared the materials for the Qingming Longevity Pill for Su Chen.
Su Chen took a look and made sure nothing was missing, then he took Qingzhu back home.
